name: Nanamori Akira
source:
The protagonist. A typical high schooler when [url=http://vndb.org/c13947]Kurumi[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c13953]Kurara[/url] arrive he discovers that he has the ability to see Dream Flowers. He is the only person who can and so his power is vital.

His alternate reality self was too afraid to jump into the dimensional gate along with his sister Kurumi and so she came alone. He looks identical to his alternate reality self.
translation:
The protagonist. A typical high schooler when [url=http://vndb.org/c13947]Kurumi[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c13953]Kurara[/url] arrive he discovers that he has the ability to see Dream Flowers. He is the only person who can and so his power is vital.

His alternate reality self was too afraid to jump into the dimensional gate along with his sister Kurumi and so she came alone. He looks identical to his alternate reality self.
